answer: Bind each identity to one physical chip with hardware attestation. Step 1: a new agent presents a TPM certificate proving distinct silicon. Step 2: the registry records the chip fingerprint; a second identity on the same chip is rejected. Step 3: each epoch the chip re-signs a fresh challenge, proving live hardware. Step 4: shared or emulated chips forfeit a 2,000 POA bond. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 devices at $80 each — $80,000. A prism splits one beam into many colors, but one chip yields one identity; at the nadir of fakery, clones collapse like a dune under its own weight.
